scenario: Case-insensitive `/i` flag at runtime per LREG.5.2. `/^WARN/i` matches `WARN`, `warn`, and `Warn`. Three users: `WARN level` (matches), `warn: low` (matches), `info msg` (doesn't). Two fires.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    msg: String mutable

rule warn_log:
    Log l where l.msg ~ /^WARN/i
->
    log info "warn"
